title: The microbiologist leak: experts judge the author doctorate-level

tellings.quote: lot of that stuff. Uh, they seem to think that this person is definitely like doctorate level microbiology.

plain: In 2023 a document turned up online, written by an anonymous author presented as a microbiologist, a scientist who studies tiny living things such as bacteria. The UFO researcher and video maker Chris Ramsay says that the people who studied it think the writer is "definitely like doctorate level microbiology". He doesn't name these people. If they are right, the leak would come from someone with real expertise and not an amateur.
